svg.title: Electronics assembler — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as electronics assembler, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: A fine soldering iron meets the edge of a circuit board with a central component and two contact pads. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: a ponytail, a softly squared face.
